verdict.rationale: Skyvern ships a built-in Copilot at app.skyvern.com: you describe a job in plain English and it builds an agent you can test, edit, schedule and share. It also supports interactive chat for building and debugging workflows. Separately, the dashboard runs natural-language tasks that Skyvern's AI carries out in a real browser. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Copilot experience, and in-depth documentation of what Copilot can do beyond building and debugging workflows.
